postMortem: Impact: 39,667 UPI transactions failed or went DEEMED; SBI customers most affected. No internal change preceded it. Root cause: SBI unannounced maintenance on its UPI switch; upi-gateway kept routing at full rate. upi-gateway had no per-bank circuit breaker, so 30s NPCI timeouts for SBI saturated the shared npci-client thread pool and dragged success rate down for every bank. Resolution: opened the SBI circuit breaker manually, routed SBI via the secondary NPCI endpoint and isolated it in a bulkhead thread pool (by Rahul Verma, TTR 69 min). What did NOT work: bulk-retried failed ReqPay calls (risk of duplicate debits; stopped by payments lead); restarted upi-gateway pods (timeouts returned immediately; cause is external). Action items: Per-bank bulkheads in npci-client; Auto circuit breaker per payer_psp; Status page template for partner-bank degradation.
